description: Search one domain's mailbox for text (at least 2 characters) in the subject, the sender, the recipient or the body. Returns addressing, the subject and a short preview per hit — never the body. Call `get_email` with a hit's `messageId` to read the content of the one that matters. Use `list_domains` to get the `domainId`.

field.description: Which field to match. Defaults to `body` (subject, from, to and body text).

limit.description: Maximum number of hits to return (default 20).

q.description: The text to look for. At least 2 characters; a case-insensitive substring.

type.description: Which mailbox direction to search. Defaults to `receive`.

name: search_emails
